configuration.description: Build configuration for the agent + tool.

serverGc.description: Enable .NET Server GC (throughput-oriented). Baked into the Release build (serverGcMode=publish) or applied at runtime (serverGcMode=runtime).

serverGcMode.description: publish = bake -p:ServerGarbageCollection into the build (default); runtime = set DOTNET_gcServer env at launch.

rebuild.description: Republish the agent + tool before running (dev mode).

runtime.description: RID for the portable/self-contained export bundle, e.g. win-x64, linux-x64.

selfContained.description: Publish the export bundle self-contained (no .NET runtime required on the target).

projectPath.description: Path (repo-relative) to the agent host csproj to publish in dev mode.

configDir.description: Folder holding the live appsettings/catalogData/contractData/nlog.config the harness reads for topology and copies next to the agent.

startupTimeoutSec.description: Max seconds to wait for the agent inbound port to open.

restartPerScenario.description: Restart the agent for each scenario for full isolation.

outputDir.description: Root folder for timestamped session results.

openAfter.description: Open the HTML report when the run finishes.

baselineDir.description: Optional previous session folder to diff against (regression %).

captureCounters.description: Capture GC/CPU via dotnet-counters if available.

p99RoundTripMs.description: Pass threshold for p99 client round-trip latency (ms).

zeroLoss.description: Fail a scenario if any message is lost.

maxThroughputRegressionPct.description: Baseline diff: flag throughput drops beyond this %.

mode.description: closed = wait for ack before next send (latency); open = paced at rateMsgsPerSec (throughput/backpressure).

warmupSec.description: Discarded warm-up window (excludes JIT + cold-connection from percentiles).

rateMsgsPerSec.description: Open-loop target rate across all connections; 0 = unbounded.

inputId.description: SourceEndpointId to drive; defaults to the first contract's first input.

idleGapSec.description: Idle gap between bursts (exercises the stale-connection reconnect).

burstSize.description: Messages per burst before the idle gap.

sizeBytes.description: Pad the message to this size (0 = template size).

ackDelayMs.description: Downstream ack delay (simulate a slow destination).

closeAfterN.description: Close each connection after N messages.

nackPct.description: Return an AE NACK for this % of messages.

idleCloseMs.description: Close a connection idle for this many ms (like the demo receiver).

agentOverrides.description: Optional per-scenario agent config overrides (patched into a sandbox + agent restart). Omit to test the CURRENT contractData as-is.
